The displayed posterior probabilities are model outputs, not independently calibrated confidence or accuracy measurements. Token contributions are additive log-likelihood ratios, not percentages. Unknown words receive Laplace-smoothed fallback values. Exact model preprocessing: lowercase + whitespace split (punctuation is retained).
